title: Your SaaS Bill Is Ridiculous
subtitle: A Skeptical Guide to Open-Source Tools That Can Replace Expensive SaaS
author: Anton BV
audience: Technical founders, operators, solo builders and engineering-minded teams trying to reduce SaaS spend without accidentally taking on a second job as unpaid infrastructure staff.
positioning: A curated discovery booklet / field guide of interesting open-source repos that may replace expensive SaaS, while staying blunt about the operational bill that still remains.
description: Compact ABVX Books discovery booklet. Primary distribution intent is FREE_PUBLICATION on abvx.xyz as a downloadable DIGITAL_PDF. The work is intentionally booklet-like rather than a conventional small book: fast intro, one-page discoveries, compact Rabbit Holes, short closing, no ceremonial book scaffolding.
source_policy: Use the supplied Russian PDF as a lead corpus only. Final English prose must be independently written from verified first-party repository and documentation sources. Do not translate or paraphrase expressive source prose section by section.
citation_policy: Treat repository READMEs, licenses, official docs and current first-party public surfaces as the primary factual basis. Non-obvious claims about what a tool replaces, what it costs and who should run it must stay evidence-backed and skeptical.

outline.title: Cover
outline.notes: Typographic black cover with restrained rust billing motif.

outline.title: Short editorial intro
outline.notes: Fast unheaded opening after the cover; no internal title page or Introduction heading.

outline.title: Discovery pages
outline.notes: Nineteen compact one-page discoveries with category eyebrow, prose, fact block and verdict strip.

outline.title: Rabbit Holes
outline.notes: Compact alternate page for three reference-only rabbit holes.

outline.title: Short closing
outline.notes: Compact closing replacing The Catch plus Final Note.

illustration_policy: Keep the book cheap and durable: strong cover, typography, compact fact strips, restrained diagrams/icons if useful, and only occasional screenshots when they materially explain the product. Avoid screenshot-heavy layouts and do not generate one illustration per repository.

checks: no filler added to hit page count

translation.proper_name_policy: Keep canonical repository names, product names and URL identities exact; translate nothing because the final book is independently authored English prose rather than a localized edition.

execution_cost.notes: This acceptance case optimizes for quality, speed and density, while keeping production cheap and local-first where reasonable. The word-count target is a planning estimate, not a quota.

expected_outcome: The discovery booklet is now published on ABVX Books as a free public DIGITAL_PDF with a live detail page and direct download URL. Any retrospective or future multi-format expansion is separate work.
